threads.body: nit: the pydantic case only re-tests `object_to_any_value`, so it adds a test dependency without covering anything new here. More broadly, many new tests patch `object_to_any_value` and `assertIs` on what reaches `set_attributes`, which pins the implementation. Asserting on the exported span/log attributes would be enough and would cut a lot of the ~600 new test lines.

threads.body: The typed-document branch now passes NaN and infinite scores through, whereas the previous converter omitted them; strict JSON consumers cannot serialize the resulting content. Agno can supply these values through `safe_float`/`format_retrieval_document`. Omit non-finite scores without converting the whole document, and add regression cases for NaN, both infinities, and zero.

threads.body: `__dataclass_fields__` includes `ClassVar` entries, unlike `fields(self)`. Consequently, a `ToolCallRequestPart` reports `'_SANITIZE' in part` as true and returns a frozenset for `part['_SANITIZE']`, even though that key is absent from iteration and the value is not an AnyValue. Restrict lookup to actual present instance fields so the newly exposed Mapping interface has consistent lookup, membership, and iteration semantics.
